Players Committee card image of [[Ahsoka's Shoto Lightsaber]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on Ahsoka or a non-[Episode I] Padawan. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value (if hit target is an Inquisitor, opponent also loses 1 Force).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ahsokasshotolightsaber.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ahsokasshotolightsaber.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
